questions.q: What does the least squares method choose?
options: The line through the first and last data points
The intercept and slope that minimize the sum of squared residuals
The line that passes through as many points as possible
The slope that makes the correlation equal to 1
questions.explain: Least squares picks the intercept and slope that make the sum of squared residuals (actual minus predicted) as small as possible.

questions.q: In a fit of price (in $ thousands) on square footage, the slope is 0.1493. What is the correct interpretation?
options: Every home costs 0.1493 thousand dollars
Adding one square foot to a specific home will raise its price by exactly $149.30
Homes that are one square foot larger are, on average, about $149 more expensive
Square footage explains 14.93 percent of the price variation
questions.explain: The slope describes the average difference in y per one-unit difference in x. With observational data it is an association, not a guaranteed effect on any one home.

questions.q: A simple regression has R-squared of 0.944. What does that mean?
options: About 94 percent of the variation in the outcome is accounted for by the predictor
The predictions are correct 94 percent of the time
The slope is 0.944
The p-value is 0.944
questions.explain: R-squared is the share of the variation in y explained by the model. In simple regression it equals the squared correlation.

questions.q: You fit a line using homes between 800 and 3,000 square feet. Why is predicting the price of a 10,000 square foot home risky?
options: Least squares cannot handle large numbers
The residuals would all be zero
It is fine, because a line continues forever
The relationship outside the observed range is unknown, so the line may not hold there
questions.explain: Extrapolating beyond the observed range assumes the same pattern continues, which the data cannot support.

questions.q: After fitting a line, the residual plot shows a clear U-shaped curve. What does that suggest?
options: The fit is excellent
A straight line is probably the wrong model for this relationship
The sample size is too large
The slope must equal zero
questions.explain: Residuals should look like patternless noise. A curve means the straight-line assumption is failing.
